  • it's not terribly frequent (acceptable infrequency as defined by the community)
  • the poster is contributing elsewhere in the sub, by either commenting on other posts or submitting content in addition to the self-promotion.

The parts I'd most like to tighten up in /v/gaming's content creator guidelines are phrases like "can be deleted by the moderator if it’s getting annoying." We haven't had problems with this in the past just because /v/gaming modteam has been good at only acting when we receiver user reports, but I'm always in favor of eliminating as much moderator discretion as possible so that rules are plain, predictable, and applied as consistently as possible.

Cinnamon Cream Cheese Rolls

Ingredients

2 tubes (8 ounces each) refrigerated crescent rolls

2 packages (8 ounces each) cream cheese, softened

1-1/2 cups sugar, divided

1 teaspoon vanilla extract

¼ cup butter, melted

1 teaspoon ground cinnamon

Instructions

Unroll one tube of dough and place in a lightly greased 13-in. x 9-in. baking pan.

In a large bowl, beat the cream cheese, 1 cup of sugar and vanilla until smooth. Spread over dough.

Unroll remaining tube of dough and place over cream cheese mixture, stretching to fit.

Brush butter evenly over top; sprinkle with cinnamon and remaining sugar.

Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

Cool; cut into squares.
